svg.title: The m-devbox developer stack
svg.desc: What you work in: VS Code served in your browser by code-server, with the m-vscode extension, companion extensions, the Cline assistant and the guides; the editor calls m. Below it the stack, from your code down: your code at /work, the M Standard Library, the m toolchain built on m-parse, the tree-sitter-m grammar and m-standard data, the driver seam (m-driver-sdk and m-ydb), five native call-outs, YottaDB r2.06, and the container. m-iris, the IRIS driver, is not in the image.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: m-devbox: the whole M developer stack in one image
